subject: Life Sciences

caps_source.title: Life Sciences CAPS Grades 10-12
alignment_notes: Grade 12 recommended sequence includes Diversity, Change and Continuity: Darwinism and Human Evolution.

source_type_reasons: FET old-paper catalogue for Life Sciences shows diagrams, tables and graphs as repeated source/stimulus types.
CAPS Life Sciences assessment requires practical/investigation and data interpretation competence.
Grade 12 Term 3 content focus is evolution, natural selection and human evolution.

assessment_content_focus: Evolution by natural selection and speciation
Interpreting biological diagrams, data tables and graphs

required_visuals.title: Science data table or graph stimulus
required_visuals.assessment_use: Learners calculate, compare, interpret trends, and support conclusions from data.

required_visuals.title: Investigation method and data sheet
required_visuals.assessment_use: Learners identify variables, evaluate method quality, and draw a supported conclusion.

required_visuals.title: Science labelled diagram stimulus
must_show: visible arrows or stages where needed
required_visuals.assessment_use: Learners identify, label, compare, and explain using the diagram.

generation_constraints: Every question that refers to a figure must use Figure 1, Figure 2 or Figure 3 supplied in the paper.
Questions must require learners to interpret evidence, not merely recall isolated definitions.
